title: Hotplug queue overflow: dropped events are silent
description: WP11_HOTPLUG_QUEUE_SIZE is 64 events. Rapid USB hotplug beyond that silently drops events and increments g_hotplug_dropped, which callers cannot observe. A token arrival event lost to overflow means the application never sees the new slot. Options: wake all C_WaitForSlotEvent waiters to re-poll actual slot list on overflow, or expose the dropped counter via a diagnostic slot event type.
